items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: All three built items (4.4 release action, 6 last-run staleness, 7 open-register finding) match the task brief and FR-01.70 AC section (B)-(D); no extra endpoints or features added.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: All three routes distinguish ENOENT/symlink/path-traversal/malformed-JSON/lock-contention with distinct status codes (200/400/403/502/409); no unhandled throw reaches the client (verified by the confidence probes' concurrent-race test).

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: No SQL/HTML surfaces here; leadId is regex-validated (LEAD_ID_RE) before any fs access, sessionId is UUID-regex-validated, reason is length-capped; the three new routes sit behind the SAME router-level host+secret gate as the rest of the org family (routes.ts:77-89), never re-derived per handler.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: 56 tests across 6 files assert on HTTP status + response body / on-disk file state, never internal call counts; every route has at least one happy-path and multiple error-path cases (symlink, malformed JSON, invalid leadId, lock contention, not-found).

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: Single bounded file reads per request, no loops of I/O, no unbounded lists (register entries are bounded by leadwright's own file, which this run never grows).

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: All new files live under server/src/external/org/ matching the existing route-family layout; each is under 300 lines (74/114/178/252/284); beat-register.ts was split from an original 533-line draft specifically to satisfy this.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Three producer/consumer pairs identified (leadwright-writes -> webui-reads for last-run.json + org-chart.json; webui-writes/leadwright-reads for the release action's register mutation + audit append). Four empirical probes run (round-trip across route modules, real concurrent-lock race, embedded-newline round-trip, UTF-8 BOM) -- see the iterate spec's Confidence Calibration section. All four found nothing requiring a code change; asymptote reached.

items.name: Test Hygiene Probe
items.note: scan_test_hygiene.py --diff reported no findings across the six new/changed test files.
